Resp  O R D E R Delay condoned.
Permission to file petition granted.
Respondent no. 1 has not appeared, though notice is duly served.
Leave granted.
Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.
Perusal of the impugned order shows that compensation amount was deposited.
Reliance is placed in that behalf on the counter affidavit filed before the High Court which has been quoted in paragraph 5 of the impugned judgment.

The impugned judgment relies upon a decision of this Court in Pune Municipal Corporation & Anr.
vs. Harakchand Misirimal Solanki & Ors. reported at (2014) 3 SCC 183.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
The said decision is no longer a good law in view of the decision of the Constitution Bench in the case of Indore Development Authority vs Manoharlal And Ors. Etc. reported in 2020(8) SCC 129.
In view of what is held in paragraph 366.3 by the Constitution Bench and the fact that the compensation amount was deposited, the impugned judgment which holds that the acquisition lapsed in view of sub-section 2 of Section 24 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 cannot be sustained.
